title: Protective effect of Pinacidil on hypoxic-reoxygenated cardiomyocytes in vitro and in vivo via HIF-1alpha/HRE pathway.
authors: Wang, Ying; Wang, Jiaqi; Chen, Liangen; Zhou, Wenjing; He, Haifeng; Chen, Xiyuan; Wang, Haiying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Pinacidil对心肌细胞缺氧复氧损伤的保护作用及HIF-1alpha通路，虽含分子对接但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cardiomyocyte hypoxia-reoxygenation (HR) is considered as a major cause of heart failure. Pinacidil is a classic ATP sensitive potassium channel opener and plays a crucial role in cardiomyocyte HR injuries. However, the specific mechanism is poorly understood. We established HR rat model and introduced 5-Hydroxydecanoate (5-HD), N-(2-Mercaptopropionyl)-glycine (MPG), and Dimethylethylenediylglycine (DMOG) to investigate the protection of Pinacidil (P) on cardiomyocyte. HE staining, electron microscopy and JC-1 staining were used to observe mitochondrial structure and mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP). Reactive oxygen species (ROS), hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha), vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A), heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), and induced nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) were analyzed in this study. Network pharmacology analysis and auto-docking were used to predict the possible target of Pinadicil under cardiomyocyte HR condition. The integrity of mitochondrial structure and MMP were effectively promoted in P and MPG+DMOG + P groups. ROS was significantly increased after HR, treatment with P or MPG+DMOG + P, the content of ROS was increased. The expressions of HIF-1alpha, VEGF-A, HO-1 and iNOS were significantly increased in P and MPG+DMOG + P groups compared with HR group. Docking results confirmed that prolyl hydroxylase (PHD) was the most possible target for unsaturated binding with Pinacidil guanidine. Altogether, these data indicate that Pinacidil up-regulated and activated HIF-1alpha protein to protect caridomyocytes against HR injuries and the mechanism may be related to Pinacidil guanidine binding to PHD.
abstract_zh: 心肌细胞缺氧-复氧（HR）被认为是心力衰竭的主要原因。吡那地尔（Pinacidil）是一种经典的ATP敏感钾通道开放剂，在心肌细胞HR损伤中发挥关键作用。然而，其具体机制尚不清楚。我们建立了HR大鼠模型，并引入5-羟基癸酸（5-HD）、N-(2-巯基丙酰基)-甘氨酸（MPG）和二甲基乙二酰甘氨酸（DMOG），以研究吡那地尔（P）对心肌细胞的保护作用。采用HE染色、电子显微镜和JC-1染色观察线粒体结构和线粒体膜电位（MMP）。本研究分析了活性氧（ROS）、缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）、血管内皮生长因子A（VEGF-A）、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）和诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）。通过网络药理学分析和自动对接预测吡那地尔在心肌细胞HR条件下的可能靶点。在P组和MPG+DMOG+P组中，线粒体结构的完整性和MMP得到有效促进。HR后ROS显著增加，经P或MPG+DMOG+P处理后，ROS含量增加。与HR组相比，P组和MPG+DMOG+P组中HIF-1α、VEGF-A、HO-1和iNOS的表达显著增加。对接结果证实，脯氨酰羟化酶（PHD）是与吡那地尔胍基不饱和结合的最可能靶点。总之，这些数据表明，吡那地尔上调并激活HIF-1α蛋白以保护心肌细胞免受HR损伤，其机制可能与吡那地尔胍基结合PHD有关。
